## Murder Level[]
**MDR** (**Murder Level**) is an entirely internal statistic that tracks the protagonist's progress through the Genocide Route.[[5]](https://undertale.fandom.com/wiki/Stats#cite_note-5) This statistic begins at 0 on every playthrough and is reset by a simple Reset. The murder level is accessed a few times in-game, notably to affect types of bosses encountered and boss activity (including whether or not the protagonist battles Sans), and to trigger the Alphys Ending variant of the Neutral Route.
Flags in the protagonist's save file are accessed and used to determine the choices the protagonist has made, and whether or not those choices fulfill the requirements for a complete or aborted Genocide Route attempt. Except for the murder level override, each step increments the murder level _only if all of the requirements preceding it have been fulfilled_. For example, if the protagonist has killed Toriel but did not exhaust the Ruins kill counter beforehand, the murder level remains at 0.
The line number listed below corresponds to the line number in the protagonist's SAVE file, i.e. 31 greater than the flag number.

**Stats** are values that affect encounters. They are usually increased with LV or equipment, but some can be altered by other methods.

## HP[edit | edit source]
**HP** (**Hit Points**) function similarly to _Undertale_. Clover starts with a maximum of 20 HP and can only increase this through increasing their LV. HP can be restored at SAVE points, through consumables, or by touching green attacks. They can also be restored by a successful shot with the Glass Ammo equipped or when using certain acts during the final boss fight of each route. Clover loses HP when damaged in a fight. They also are knocked down to 1 HP after crashing off of UG Aviator, Martlet's raft. Hitting 0 HP causes a game over and makes Clover reload from their last SAVE.
In the Wild East Clinic, Clover can supercharge their HP by paying 30G. This puts them 15 over the maximum. They can only repeat this process after their HP has dropped to their normal maximum or below.

## AT[edit | edit source]
**AT** (**Attack**) is the damage Clover deals in battle. It has two components, primary and secondary. Primary AT starts at 10 and can only be increased by increasing Clover's LV. Secondary AT starts at 0 and is the amount of damage specific ammo does.
More damage is dealt the closer to the center Clover hits in the FIGHT interface and the more of the rings they successfully hit with certain ammo or the Wild Revolver. A perfect hit with the Wild Revolver also does more damage than a perfect hit with the Toy Gun. Once a monster can be killed in the next turn with a maximum damage attack given Clover's and the monster's stats, they will always be killed if Clover successfully shoots them again no matter how little damage Clover deals. If the monster has been damaged in battle before they reach this point, they become spareable.

## DF[edit | edit source]
**DF** (**Defense**) is the damage Clover resists during battle. Similarly to AT, primary DF starts at 10 and is increased with LV while secondary DF starts at 0 and is increased with accessories.
Unlike _Undertale_, which takes 1/5 of Frisk's defense into consideration when calculating resistance, _Undertale Yellow_ calculates more directly. Every 1 DF is equal to 1 HP protected against when Clover takes a hit. This makes DF much more useful in _Undertale Yellow_.
On Easy Mode, the Worn Hat and Nice Hat increase defense by 3.

## EXP / LOVE[edit | edit source]
**EXP** stands for **Execution Points**, though this is not explained in _Undertale Yellow_. It is increased by killing monsters. Killing robots, with the exception of Axis, does not grant EXP, and neither does killing Ceroba Ketsukane in the Flawed Pacifist Ending. Like in _Undertale_, killing Flowey at the end of the Genocide Route does not grant EXP.
**LV**, also known as **LOVE**, stands for **Level of Violence**, which is not explained in _Undertale Yellow_ either. It is analogous to the levelling system in many RPGs and controls maximum HP, primary AT, and primary DF. It is increased by reaching certain EXP thresholds. On the Genocide Route, the Axis battle automatically levels Clover up from their current LV (either 12 or 13, depending on monsters killed beforehand) to LV 19.

## PP[edit | edit source]
**PP** (**Protection Points**) are the amount of hits that Clover is immune to. They are increased in one of three ways. The first is by eating the Golden Pear, which increases PP by 2. The second is, if Clover's PP is 0 and they start a battle in the Steamworks when Ceroba is accompanying, Ceroba increases Clover's PP by 1. The three exceptions to this are the Macro Froggit battle, where she is never present, and the Guardener and Axis fights, where she shields them partway through as soon as she becomes able. The third is using the Hope act during the Ceroba Pacifist boss battle, which increases PP by 1.

## SP[edit | edit source]
**SP** (**Speed Points**) are the amount of turns that Clover's SOUL will move faster in battle. Drinking the Sea Tea, making a successful shot with the Coffee Bean Ammo, or using the Remember act during the Ceroba Pacifist boss battle increases this by 1. Drinking the Golden Coffee increases this by 3.

## RP[edit | edit source]
**RP** (**Restoration Points**) are the amount of turns that Clover will recover HP for. They can only be increased by using the Golden Cactus, which increases RP by 3.

## Stat Chart[edit | edit source]
Until LV 20, HP is calculated as 16 + (4 × LV), AT is calculated as (2 × LV) + 8, and DF is calculated as (LV - 1) ÷ 4 + 10, rounded down. Unlike _Undertale_, the AT and DF shown in the Stats menu match their internal value.

## Trivia[edit | edit source]
*   Levels 14 through 18 are only able to be seen when rapidly leveling up at the end of the Axis battle on a Genocide Route. The stats of these levels, excluding HP, are not visible in normal gameplay but are still set internally.  
*   There are maximum values in place for SP, RP, and PP, preventing these values from exceeding 99. Despite being impossible to change ingame, these values are saved to the save file as stats, similar to max HP, allowing modification of these limits.   
    *   PP and SP cannot reach these values during normal gameplay, as there are no ways to renewably and indefinitely increase them. However, due to a glitch, RP is never properly saved at any point, and only reset following an overworld load, allowing it to be indefinitely accumulated until its maximum by dying, then using the retry feature before the effect wears off.

LOVE means Level of Violence, same with LV. EXP additionally means Execution Points.

## **Info**[]
LV 1 Frisk, sometimes referred to as LOVE 1 Frisk, is a challenge in UnderTale Test Place Reborn which can be turned on via the "LV 1 Frisk" setting. If on, the user will spawn in as LV 1 Frisk with only 20 HP and a pathetic 3 defense, along with only having the Stick and Bandage available. Note that the user cannot do the LV 1 Frisk challenge if their kill streak is 20 or above. To avoid unfair deaths, KDR is turned off for LV 1 Frisk users. Leaving the server/disconnecting will cause the player to lose ALL LV and EXP, forcing them to start over.

## **Info**[]
### Gaining LOVE[]
LV, like in UnderTale, is obtained by getting enough EXP, which is obtained by killing players. Additionally, like in the UnderTale Demo, EXP is obtained by damaging players as well. Frisk will still get EXP if the opponent they are fighting leaves the game, disconnects, or exits combat by accepting a challenge from another user. Killing players is the main way of getting EXP, as it grants a lot, as only damaging players gives a low amount of EXP. EXP cannot be obtained by damaging dodge health characters, like Sans, but they will still give EXP for killing them. It is best to avoid fighting dodge health characters and fight characters with large amounts of normal HP, like Asgore instead, to get more EXP. _**Every time Frisk's LV goes up, they get fully healed.**_ If killing or damaging the opponent while in Phase 2, the EXP bar will go up, but it has no effect, meaning there is no reason to try to win while in Phase 2, besides practice.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 1[]
All LV 1 Frisk users spawn at this LV when first joining the server. Frisk at this LV has 20 HP and 3 defense, along with the Bandage and Stick, totaling to 0[+1] Attack and 3[+40] Defense assuming the items were equipped. Frisk at this LV is one shot by almost every attack in the game, due to only having 43 Defense max, lower than even glass canons. No combo opportunities are available due to only having the Stick as a weapon and the Bandage as armor.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 2[]
Almost the same as LV 1, but Frisk has 24 HP and 6 Defense instead, along with keeping the Bandage and Stick. Frisk at this LV has a little bit more survivability, possibly being able to survive some characters LMBs. Still no combo opportunities.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 3[]
LV 3 gives Frisk the Toy Knife and Faded Ribbon, along with 28 HP and 9 Defense. Equipping the Toy Knife and Faded Ribbon gives 0[+13] Attack and 9[+180] Defense, which is a very high defense, but has low effect due to the low HP. A "combo" is available at this with Toy Knife full LMB (or Stick full LMB) then Toy Knife 1.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 4[]
LV 4 is mostly the same as LV 3, but with 32 HP and 12 Defense. Still only one "combo".

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 5[]
LV 5 has 36 HP and 15 Defense. The music is replaced with "But Nobody Came" at this LV, which cannot be changed back to normal, making it quite annoying. It is a reference to the Genocide Route in UnderTale, as in UnderTale, "But Nobody Came" plays after having a encounter after killing every single monster in the area.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 6[]
LV 6 gives Frisk 40 HP and 18 Defense, along with the Tough Gloves and Manly Bandanna, opening up more combo opportunities with the Tough Gloves, and the Manly Bandanna can give more attack without sacrificing too much defense. Equipping the Tough Gloves and Manly Bandanna gives 0[+48] Attack and 18[+130] Defense, which is good stats for the most part.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 7[]
LV 7 gives Frisk 44 HP and 21 Defense. Nothing interesting or special is at this LV.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 8[]
LV 8 gives Frisk 48 HP and 24 Defense. Still nothing unlocked or special at this LV.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 9[]
LV 9 gives Frisk 52 HP and 27 Defense. Unlike with the Tough Gloves, Toy Knife, and their respective armors, which were unlocked at LV 6 and LV 3 respectively, nothing is obtained at this LV.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 10[]
LV 10 gives Frisk 56 HP and 30 Defense, along with the Ballet Shoes and Old Tutu, which unlocks many combo opportunities. The Ballet Shoes are good for doing extra end of LMB damage by using the weapon you were using (example: tough gloves) and on the second to last LMB, quickly switch to the Ballet Shoes and do the final LMB, which will deal a bit of extra damage to the opponent. The Old Tutu can be good for finding victims faster to kill, as it increases Frisk's run speed. Equipping both the Ballet Shoes and Old Tutu gives Frisk 0[+26] Attack and 30[+130] Defense.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 11[]
LV 11 gives Frisk 60 HP and 33 Defense, with nothing else.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 12[]
LV 12 gives Frisk 64 HP and 36 Defense, along with 2 extremely powerful items: the Torn Notebook to _finally_ be able to counter, and the Cloudy Glasses, which opens up MANY powerful combo opportunities, which can deal large damage, finally making Frisk not seem nearly as much as a weakling. With the Torn Notebook, Frisk can counter attacks, but Frisk cannot get a combo in unless the victim has low stamina, and the Cloudy Glasses steal stamina as long as Frisk has below 20 stamina and the victim has above 7 stamina, which can lead to free stamina punishes, allowing large damage, even without all the weapons Frisk normally has. Equipping the Torn Notebook and Cloudy Glasses gives Frisk 0[+1] Attack and 36[+195] Defense.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 13[]
LV 13 gives Frisk 68 HP and 39 Defense, but nothing else.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 14[]
LV 14 gives Frisk 72 HP and 42 Defense, but still without anything else.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 15[]
LV 15 gives Frisk 76 HP and 45 Defense, along with the Burnt Pan and Stained Apron. This gives Frisk the ability to finally heal themself, which adds a lot of extra HP and survivability. The Stained Apron has pretty good defense, and the Burnt Pan gives attack and defense, which can be used with the Faded Ribbon to tank damage. Equipping the Burnt Pan and Stained Apron gives Frisk 0[+22] Attack and 45[+210] Defense.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 16[]
LV 16 gives Frisk 80 HP and 48 Defense, but nothing else.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 17[]
LV 17 gives Frisk 84 HP and 51 Defense, along with the "Empty" Gun and the Cowboy Hat, both very useful items. The "Empty" Gun can be used for combo ending or extending at low stamina, and the Cowboy Hat is good for defense and attack. At this point, Frisk is almost like normal, just without the Worn Dagger or Temmie Armor. Equipping the "Empty" Gun and Cowboy Hat gives Frisk 0[+56] Attack and 51[+160] Defense.

## HP[edit | edit source]
**HP** (**Hit Points**) function similarly to _Undertale_. Clover starts with a maximum of 20 HP and can only increase this through increasing their LV. HP can be restored at SAVE points, through consumables, or by touching green attacks. They can also be restored by a successful shot with the Glass Ammo equipped or when using certain acts during the final boss fight of each route. Clover loses HP when damaged in a fight. They also are knocked down to 1 HP after crashing off of UG Aviator, Martlet's raft. Hitting 0 HP causes a game over and makes Clover reload from their last SAVE.
In the Wild East Clinic, Clover can supercharge their HP by paying 30G. This puts them 15 over the maximum. They can only repeat this process after their HP has dropped to their normal maximum or below.
texts.2:
## AT[edit | edit source]
**AT** (**Attack**) is the damage Clover deals in battle. It has two components, primary and secondary. Primary AT starts at 10 and can only be increased by increasing Clover's LV. Secondary AT starts at 0 and is the amount of damage specific ammo does.
More damage is dealt the closer to the center Clover hits in the FIGHT interface and the more of the rings they successfully hit with certain ammo or the Wild Revolver. A perfect hit with the Wild Revolver also does more damage than a perfect hit with the Toy Gun. Once a monster can be killed in the next turn with a maximum damage attack given Clover's and the monster's stats, they will always be killed if Clover successfully shoots them again no matter how little damage Clover deals. If the monster has been damaged in battle before they reach this point, they become spareable.
texts.3:
## DF[edit | edit source]
**DF** (**Defense**) is the damage Clover resists during battle. Similarly to AT, primary DF starts at 10 and is increased with LV while secondary DF starts at 0 and is increased with accessories.
Unlike _Undertale_, which takes 1/5 of Frisk's defense into consideration when calculating resistance, _Undertale Yellow_ calculates more directly. Every 1 DF is equal to 1 HP protected against when Clover takes a hit. This makes DF much more useful in _Undertale Yellow_.
On Easy Mode, the Worn Hat and Nice Hat increase defense by 3.
texts.4:
## EXP / LOVE[edit | edit source]
**EXP** stands for **Execution Points**, though this is not explained in _Undertale Yellow_. It is increased by killing monsters. Killing robots, with the exception of Axis, does not grant EXP, and neither does killing Ceroba Ketsukane in the Flawed Pacifist Ending. Like in _Undertale_, killing Flowey at the end of the Genocide Route does not grant EXP.
**LV**, also known as **LOVE**, stands for **Level of Violence**, which is not explained in _Undertale Yellow_ either. It is analogous to the levelling system in many RPGs and controls maximum HP, primary AT, and primary DF. It is increased by reaching certain EXP thresholds. On the Genocide Route, the Axis battle automatically levels Clover up from their current LV (either 12 or 13, depending on monsters killed beforehand) to LV 19.
texts.5:
## PP[edit | edit source]
**PP** (**Protection Points**) are the amount of hits that Clover is immune to. They are increased in one of three ways. The first is by eating the Golden Pear, which increases PP by 2. The second is, if Clover's PP is 0 and they start a battle in the Steamworks when Ceroba is accompanying, Ceroba increases Clover's PP by 1. The three exceptions to this are the Macro Froggit battle, where she is never present, and the Guardener and Axis fights, where she shields them partway through as soon as she becomes able. The third is using the Hope act during the Ceroba Pacifist boss battle, which increases PP by 1.
texts.6:
## SP[edit | edit source]
**SP** (**Speed Points**) are the amount of turns that Clover's SOUL will move faster in battle. Drinking the Sea Tea, making a successful shot with the Coffee Bean Ammo, or using the Remember act during the Ceroba Pacifist boss battle increases this by 1. Drinking the Golden Coffee increases this by 3.
texts.7:
## RP[edit | edit source]
**RP** (**Restoration Points**) are the amount of turns that Clover will recover HP for. They can only be increased by using the Golden Cactus, which increases RP by 3.
texts.8:
## Stat Chart[edit | edit source]
Until LV 20, HP is calculated as 16 + (4 × LV), AT is calculated as (2 × LV) + 8, and DF is calculated as (LV - 1) ÷ 4 + 10, rounded down. Unlike _Undertale_, the AT and DF shown in the Stats menu match their internal value.
texts.11:
## Trivia[edit | edit source]
*   Levels 14 through 18 are only able to be seen when rapidly leveling up at the end of the Axis battle on a Genocide Route. The stats of these levels, excluding HP, are not visible in normal gameplay but are still set internally.  
*   There are maximum values in place for SP, RP, and PP, preventing these values from exceeding 99. Despite being impossible to change ingame, these values are saved to the save file as stats, similar to max HP, allowing modification of these limits.   
    *   PP and SP cannot reach these values during normal gameplay, as there are no ways to renewably and indefinitely increase them. However, due to a glitch, RP is never properly saved at any point, and only reset following an overworld load, allowing it to be indefinitely accumulated until its maximum by dying, then using the retry feature before the effect wears off.

## Murder Level[]
**MDR** (**Murder Level**) is an entirely internal statistic that tracks the protagonist's progress through the Genocide Route.[[5]](https://undertale.fandom.com/wiki/Stats#cite_note-5) This statistic begins at 0 on every playthrough and is reset by a simple Reset. The murder level is accessed a few times in-game, notably to affect types of bosses encountered and boss activity (including whether or not the protagonist battles Sans), and to trigger the Alphys Ending variant of the Neutral Route.
Flags in the protagonist's save file are accessed and used to determine the choices the protagonist has made, and whether or not those choices fulfill the requirements for a complete or aborted Genocide Route attempt. Except for the murder level override, each step increments the murder level _only if all of the requirements preceding it have been fulfilled_. For example, if the protagonist has killed Toriel but did not exhaust the Ruins kill counter beforehand, the murder level remains at 0.
The line number listed below corresponds to the line number in the protagonist's SAVE file, i.e. 31 greater than the flag number.

## **Info**[]
LV 1 Frisk, sometimes referred to as LOVE 1 Frisk, is a challenge in UnderTale Test Place Reborn which can be turned on via the "LV 1 Frisk" setting. If on, the user will spawn in as LV 1 Frisk with only 20 HP and a pathetic 3 defense, along with only having the Stick and Bandage available. Note that the user cannot do the LV 1 Frisk challenge if their kill streak is 20 or above. To avoid unfair deaths, KDR is turned off for LV 1 Frisk users. Leaving the server/disconnecting will cause the player to lose ALL LV and EXP, forcing them to start over.
texts.2:
## **Info**[]
### Gaining LOVE[]
LV, like in UnderTale, is obtained by getting enough EXP, which is obtained by killing players. Additionally, like in the UnderTale Demo, EXP is obtained by damaging players as well. Frisk will still get EXP if the opponent they are fighting leaves the game, disconnects, or exits combat by accepting a challenge from another user. Killing players is the main way of getting EXP, as it grants a lot, as only damaging players gives a low amount of EXP. EXP cannot be obtained by damaging dodge health characters, like Sans, but they will still give EXP for killing them. It is best to avoid fighting dodge health characters and fight characters with large amounts of normal HP, like Asgore instead, to get more EXP. _**Every time Frisk's LV goes up, they get fully healed.**_ If killing or damaging the opponent while in Phase 2, the EXP bar will go up, but it has no effect, meaning there is no reason to try to win while in Phase 2, besides practice.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 1[]
All LV 1 Frisk users spawn at this LV when first joining the server. Frisk at this LV has 20 HP and 3 defense, along with the Bandage and Stick, totaling to 0[+1] Attack and 3[+40] Defense assuming the items were equipped. Frisk at this LV is one shot by almost every attack in the game, due to only having 43 Defense max, lower than even glass canons. No combo opportunities are available due to only having the Stick as a weapon and the Bandage as armor.

### LV 2[]
Almost the same as LV 1, but Frisk has 24 HP and 6 Defense instead, along with keeping the Bandage and Stick. Frisk at this LV has a little bit more survivability, possibly being able to survive some characters LMBs. Still no combo opportunities.

LV 3 gives Frisk the Toy Knife and Faded Ribbon, along with 28 HP and 9 Defense. Equipping the Toy Knife and Faded Ribbon gives 0[+13] Attack and 9[+180] Defense, which is a very high defense, but has low effect due to the low HP. A "combo" is available at this with Toy Knife full LMB (or Stick full LMB) then Toy Knife 1.

LV 4 is mostly the same as LV 3, but with 32 HP and 12 Defense. Still only one "combo".

### LV 5[]
LV 5 has 36 HP and 15 Defense. The music is replaced with "But Nobody Came" at this LV, which cannot be changed back to normal, making it quite annoying. LV 6 gives Frisk 40 HP and 18 Defense, along with the Tough Gloves and Manly Bandanna, opening up more combo opportunities with the Tough Gloves, and the Manly Bandanna can give more attack without sacrificing too much defense. ### LV 10[]
LV 10 gives Frisk 56 HP and 30 Defense, along with the Ballet Shoes and Old Tutu, which unlocks many combo opportunities. ### LV 12[]
LV 12 gives Frisk 64 HP and 36 Defense, along with 2 extremely powerful items: the Torn Notebook to _finally_ be able to counter, and the Cloudy Glasses, which opens up MANY powerful combo opportunities, which can deal large damage, finally making Frisk not seem nearly as much as a weakling. Drinking the Sea Tea, making a successful shot with the Coffee Bean Ammo, or using the Remember act during the Ceroba Pacifist boss battle increases this by 1. Drinking the Golden Coffee increases this by 3.

## RP[edit | edit source]
**RP** (**Restoration Points**) are the amount of turns that Clover will recover HP for. They can only be increased by using the Golden Cactus, which increases RP by 3.

## Murder Level[]
**MDR** (**Murder Level**) is an entirely internal statistic that tracks the protagonist's progress through the Genocide Route.[[5]](https://undertale.fandom.com/wiki/Stats#cite_note-5) This statistic begins at 0 on every playthrough and is reset by a simple Reset. The murder level is accessed a few times in-game, notably to affect types of bosses encountered and boss activity (including whether or not the protagonist battles Sans), and to trigger the Alphys Ending variant of the Neutral Route.
Flags in the protagonist's save file are accessed and used to determine the choices the protagonist has made, and whether or not those choices fulfill the requirements for a complete or aborted Genocide Route attempt. Except for the murder level override, each step increments the murder level _only if all of the requirements preceding it have been fulfilled_. For example, if the protagonist has killed Toriel but did not exhaust the Ruins kill counter beforehand, the murder level remains at 0.

## **Info**[]
LV 1 Frisk, sometimes referred to as LOVE 1 Frisk, is a challenge in UnderTale Test Place Reborn which can be turned on via the "LV 1 Frisk" setting. If on, the user will spawn in as LV 1 Frisk with only 20 HP and a pathetic 3 defense, along with only having the Stick and Bandage available. Note that the user cannot do the LV 1 Frisk challenge if their kill streak is 20 or above. To avoid unfair deaths, KDR is turned off for LV 1 Frisk users. Leaving the server/disconnecting will cause the player to lose ALL LV and EXP, forcing them to start over.

## **Info**[]
### Gaining LOVE[]
LV, like in UnderTale, is obtained by getting enough EXP, which is obtained by killing players. Additionally, like in the UnderTale Demo, EXP is obtained by damaging players as well. Frisk will still get EXP if the opponent they are fighting leaves the game, disconnects, or exits combat by accepting a challenge from another user. Killing players is the main way of getting EXP, as it grants a lot, as only damaging players gives a low amount of EXP. EXP cannot be obtained by damaging dodge health characters, like Sans, but they will still give EXP for killing them. It is best to avoid fighting dodge health characters and fight characters with large amounts of normal HP, like Asgore instead, to get more EXP. _**Every time Frisk's LV goes up, they get fully healed.**_ If killing or damaging the opponent while in Phase 2, the EXP bar will go up, but it has no effect, meaning there is no reason to try to win while in Phase 2, besides practice.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 1[]
All LV 1 Frisk users spawn at this LV when first joining the server. Frisk at this LV has 20 HP and 3 defense, along with the Bandage and Stick, totaling to 0[+1] Attack and 3[+40] Defense assuming the items were equipped. Frisk at this LV is one shot by almost every attack in the game, due to only having 43 Defense max, lower than even glass canons. No combo opportunities are available due to only having the Stick as a weapon and the Bandage as armor.

## LOVE Levels[]
### LV 2[]
Almost the same as LV 1, but Frisk has 24 HP and 6 Defense instead, along with keeping the Bandage and Stick. Frisk at this LV has a little bit more survivability, possibly being able to survive some characters LMBs. Still no combo opportunities.

LV 3 gives Frisk the Toy Knife and Faded Ribbon, along with 28 HP and 9 Defense. Equipping the Toy Knife and Faded Ribbon gives 0[+13] Attack and 9[+180] Defense, which is a very high defense, but has low effect due to the low HP. A "combo" is available at this with Toy Knife full LMB (or Stick full LMB) then Toy Knife 1.

LV 4 is mostly the same as LV 3, but with 32 HP and 12 Defense. Still only one "combo".

It is a reference to the Genocide Route in UnderTale, as in UnderTale, "But Nobody Came" plays after having a encounter after killing every single monster in the area.

Equipping the Tough Gloves and Manly Bandanna gives 0[+48] Attack and 18[+130] Defense, which is good stats for the most part.

LV 10 gives Frisk 56 HP and 30 Defense, along with the Ballet Shoes and Old Tutu, which unlocks many combo opportunities. The Ballet Shoes are good for doing extra end of LMB damage by using the weapon you were using (example: tough gloves) and on the second to last LMB, quickly switch to the Ballet Shoes and do the final LMB, which will deal a bit of extra damage to the opponent. The Old Tutu can be good for finding victims faster to kill, as it increases Frisk's run speed. Equipping both the Ballet Shoes and Old Tutu gives Frisk 0[+26] Attack and 30[+130] Defense.

With the Torn Notebook, Frisk can counter attacks, but Frisk cannot get a combo in unless the victim has low stamina, and the Cloudy Glasses steal stamina as long as Frisk has below 20 stamina and the victim has above 7 stamina, which can lead to free stamina punishes, allowing large damage, even without all the weapons Frisk normally has.
